_doc: NPC dialog for Kindra town. Schema v2: entries have either 'text' (one-liner), 'lines' (sequence), or 'select' + 'sections' (flag-based branching, first matching rule wins). Lines may be strings or commands: {set_flag}, {give_starter}, {heal_party}, {start_battle}.

intro: The fire in your bones drew you to the Pyre, young one.
Every generation, a drake chooses its partner before the journey begins.
Three hatchlings wait by the flame. Listen close — one of them is already calling to you.
Walk with it east along the Dustway. Let it show you what it can do.
Return when you have faced Warden Brask at the Scald — then the north gate will open.
post_starter: The Dustway stretches east. Wild drakes hide in the tall grass.
Battle them — your drake grows stronger with every fight.
Rest a moment by the pyre.
Warden Brask waits at the Scald. She will not go easy on you.

neighbor_fen.name: Fen
lines: Morning! Off to the Dustway already?
My old Flick used to patrol this road. Tough little thing.
Watch the tall grass on the south side — that's where they ambush you.

shopkeeper.name: Cinder
lines: We carry basic provisions for travelers heading east.
Come back once you've made some coin on the Dustway.

pyre_door.text: The Pyre hall. Warm air breathes out through the door crack. It's barred from inside.

sign_east.text: DUSTWAY ROUTE 1 →   Tall grass ahead. Wild drakes likely.

sign_north.text: THE SCALD — Warden Brask's domain. Road closed until proven worthy.
